title: Peak Hour Congestion Detection
scenario: Identify the top 3 hours of the day (by request count) for each city that contribute to > 40% of the city's daily demand.
tableSchema: trips (city_id INT, request_date DATE, request_hour INT)
hint: Calculate hourly count vs total daily count per city.
correctQuery: WITH HourlyCnt AS (SELECT city_id, request_date, request_hour, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM trips GROUP BY 1,2,3), Stats AS (SELECT *, SUM(cnt) OVER(PARTITION BY city_id, request_date) as daily_tot FROM HourlyCnt) SELECT city_id, request_hour FROM Stats WHERE cnt::NUMERIC / daily_tot > 0.4 ORDER BY city_id, cnt DESC;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE trips (city_id INT, request_date DATE, request_hour INT);
